{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check how many rows have NaN in revenue after conversion
print(sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum())

# Look at the rows where revenue is NaN to understand the cause
print(sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isnull()])"}
